taxonomy_note: Planning lens only; actual root-cause mapping is independent.

controls.boundary: Model/checkpoint trust and executable deserialization — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect loader/library version, artifact format, remote-code options, repository revision/digest and producer trust. Follow conversion or nested loading paths, not just the file extension.
controls.controlled_verification: Inspect unknown artifacts statically with supported data-only tooling; use an inert owned artifact if a load test is necessary. Determine whether load-time object construction or repository code runs before trust verification. Never load a downloaded unknown checkpoint to inspect whether it is dangerous.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A filename ending in a familiar extension is not a loader guarantee. A safer option/default is version-specific and is not a universal sandbox against all resource or code risks.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use appropriate data-only/restricted formats and verified provenance with explicit remote-code authority. Retest intended model loading and the original untrusted code/object boundary in isolation.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
